title: My Hometown
text: I come from a small city in the south of Taiwan. It is not famous, but it is a lovely place to live. The streets are quiet and the people are very friendly. In the morning, many old people do exercise in the park. There is a busy night market near my home, and it sells delicious local food. My favourite dish is beef noodle soup. In the past, most young people stayed in the city and worked on farms. Nowadays, a lot of them move to big cities such as Taipei because there are more jobs there. As a result, my hometown is becoming older. However, the local government is trying to attract young people back. It has built new cafes and a modern library. I think my hometown will change a lot in the future, but I hope it keeps its friendly atmosphere.

phrases: It's located in the south of ...
qs.a: I come from a small city in the south of Taiwan. It isn't very famous, but it's well known for its night market and delicious local food.

qs.q: What do you like most about your hometown?
phrases: It gives me a sense of ...
qs.a: What I like most is the people. They are really friendly, and it gives me a sense of belonging whenever I go back.

qs.q: Why do many young people leave their hometowns?
qs.a: The main reason is that big cities offer more jobs and higher salaries. On top of that, young people want a more exciting life. As a result, many small towns are becoming older.

title: Living with Smartphones
text: Today, almost everyone has a smartphone. We use it to send messages, take photos, pay for things and watch videos. It is hard to imagine life without one. Smartphones make our lives much more convenient. For example, I can check the weather, find a restaurant and book a ticket in just a few minutes. They also help us keep in touch with friends who live far away. However, there are some problems too. Many people spend too much time looking at their screens. Some of them stay up late at night, so they feel tired the next day. Children may also stop playing outside and talking to their families. In my opinion, technology itself is not bad. The important thing is how we use it. If we set a time limit and put our phones away during meals, we can enjoy the benefits without the problems.

qs.q: How often do you use your phone?
qs.a: To be honest, I use it pretty much all day. I mainly use it for messages and watching videos on the way to work.

qs.q: What apps do you use the most?
phrases: I also use ... from time to time
qs.a: My go-to app is LINE, because all my friends and family use it. It's really handy because I can send messages and make calls for free.

qs.q: Do you think children spend too much time on technology?
phrases: On the one hand, ... on the other hand, ...
qs.a: I'd say that many children do. On the one hand, technology can help them learn. On the other hand, they may stop playing outside, so parents should set a time limit.

title: Small Steps for the Environment
text: Pollution is one of the biggest problems in the world today. Factories and cars produce dirty air, and plastic rubbish ends up in the sea. Many scientists say that the climate is changing because of human activity. Summers are getting hotter, and storms are becoming stronger. Some people think that only governments can solve these problems. Of course, governments play an important role. They can make laws and invest in clean energy. But I believe ordinary people can help too. For instance, we can take public transport instead of driving. We can bring our own bags and bottles when we go shopping. We can also recycle paper and turn off the lights when we leave a room. These actions seem small, but if millions of people do them every day, they can make a real difference. Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility.

qs.q: Do you do anything to protect the environment?
qs.a: Yes, I try my best to recycle. Whenever I go shopping, I bring my own bag. It's become a habit now.

qs.q: Who should be responsible for protecting the environment?
qs.a: In my view, governments play the most important role, because they can make laws. At the same time, ordinary people should help too, for example by using public transport.

qs.q: What is the biggest environmental problem in your country?
phrases: I'd say the biggest problem is ...
qs.a: I'd say the biggest problem is air pollution. This is mainly because of factories and scooters. One possible solution is to invest more in clean energy.

title: Learning Beyond the Classroom
text: When I was at school, most of my lessons were about remembering facts for exams. My teachers were kind, but we did not have many chances to ask questions or share our ideas. I studied hard, but I often felt bored. Now I understand that education is not only about getting good grades. It is also about learning how to think, solve problems and work with other people. These skills are very useful in the workplace. Luckily, learning does not stop when we leave school. Today, we can learn almost anything online. There are free courses, videos and podcasts on every subject. I am learning English in my free time, and I practise speaking with a language partner every week. It is not easy, but I feel more confident each month. I think the best students are the ones who stay curious all their lives.

qs.q: Did you enjoy your time at school?
qs.a: Generally speaking, yes. My teachers were kind. What I didn't like was the pressure of exams, because we had to remember so many facts.

qs.q: Are you learning anything at the moment?
qs.a: At the moment, I'm learning English in my free time. I practise speaking every week, and I'm hoping to get a band six point five in IELTS.

qs.q: Is online learning better than learning in a classroom?
qs.a: Both have pros and cons. The biggest advantage of online learning is that it's flexible and often free. However, in a classroom, students can ask questions and work with other people.

title: Why I Love Travelling
text: Travelling is one of my favourite hobbies. Last year, I visited Japan with two of my friends. We stayed in Kyoto for five days and saw many beautiful temples and gardens. The trains were fast and always on time, and the streets were very clean. One evening, we got lost, but a kind old man walked with us to our hotel. I will never forget that. For me, travelling is not just about taking photos. It is a chance to try new food, meet local people and learn about a different culture. It also helps me become more independent, because I have to plan everything by myself. Of course, travelling can be expensive. To save money, I usually book flights early and stay in small hotels. Next year, I hope to visit the UK, so I can use my English in real life.

qs.a: Absolutely! It's one of my favourite hobbies. It's a chance to try new food and learn about a different culture.

qs.q: Where would you like to travel in the future?
qs.a: I've always wanted to visit the UK, so that I can use my English in real life and see the old buildings in London.

qs.q: What are the benefits of travelling for young people?
qs.a: First of all, it helps them become more independent, because they have to plan everything. Another benefit is that it can broaden their horizons.

title: A Healthy Lifestyle
text: Many people want to be healthy, but it is not always easy. Modern life is busy, and we often eat fast food because we do not have time to cook. We also sit in front of computers for many hours. Doctors say that a healthy lifestyle has three parts: a balanced diet, regular exercise and enough sleep. A balanced diet means eating plenty of fruit and vegetables and less sugar. Regular exercise does not have to be difficult. Even a thirty-minute walk every day can make a big difference. Sleep is often forgotten, but adults need about seven or eight hours a night. I used to stay up late and skip breakfast. Now I go to bed earlier and go jogging three times a week. I have more energy, and I feel less stressed at work. Small changes really can improve our health.

qs.q: What do you do to stay healthy?
qs.a: I try to go jogging three times a week. I've also cut down on sugar, and I go to bed earlier than before.

qs.q: Do you think you have a healthy diet?
qs.a: Not really, to be honest. I tend to eat fast food when I'm busy, so I could do better. I'm trying to eat more vegetables.

qs.q: Why do many people find it hard to stay healthy?
qs.a: The main reason is that modern life is very busy. Besides, fast food is cheap and convenient, so it's much easier to eat badly than to cook.
